name: EBS-Disk-attach
description: Fired before a disk is attached to a machine and is a read/write event. Disk Properties supported for write back are: [1] diskFullPaths, [2] diskDatastoreNames and [3] diskParentDirs. All three vsphere specific disk properties are required together for update. Rest of the properties are read-only. Note: Write back is optional for Vsphere First class disk
